svg.title: Coordinating the SUS CLINIC renovation
svg.desc: A dated timeline from the signed agreement to renovation completion and opening, paired with the construction site, an early floor plan, and contract evidence. The text focuses on coordination, cost control, and making the space operational.
svg.text: Making the agreement workable under changing site conditions

g.text: Persistent rain and mountain seepage slowed the
renovation. Schedule shifts, electrical rework, and price
changes required repeated coordination with the
I tracked scope, rework, and costs as conditions changed,
negotiated adjustments, and kept spending within the
limits I had planned. After construction, I completed
product display and operating setup before opening.

svg.text: Early floor plan · construction conditions · signed agreement
